narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation into mega-cap tech (META, MSFT, GOOGL, AVGO, AAPL, AMZN) and healthcare (ABBV, LLY, MRK, JNJ) with dark pool prints in the hundreds of millions to $1.5B range. Distribution is concentrated in financials (WFC, MS, V, AXP), staples (WMT, PG), and energy ex-CVX (XOM, GEV) — a rotation OUT of cyclicals/defensives INTO secular growth and pharma.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: CVX bullish (10/10 flow) while XOM bearish (2.87 flow) — energy sector read is bifurcated at the Top 50 level. AVGO bullish vs TXN bearish creates similar split in semis. WFC's 0.47 flow score is the sharpest single-name outlier and worth flagging against any broader financials-positive read.
